items.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
items.summary: QWEN CHAT GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope Kaggle DEMO DISCORD Introduction Today, we are excited to announce the release of Qwen3, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models. Our flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemi
items.summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布Qwen3系列大模型，其旗舰模型Qwen3-235B-A22B在编码、数学和通用能力基准上与DeepSeek-R1、o1及Gemini-2.5-Pro等顶级模型展开竞争。同时发布的还有30B的MoE模型以及轻量级的4B模型，全面覆盖不同参数规模与推理场景。

aiReview.reasonZh: Qwen3旗舰模型及系列版本的发布是开源大模型领域的重要里程碑，对标全球顶级闭源与开源大模型。
